notes: NEAR is a native asset, so ERC-style honeypot, LP-removal, token-admin freeze and deployer-dump gates do not apply in the ordinary form.
Initial token supply is described by NEAR as fully unlocked; no new unlock overhang is being treated as a blocker.
Protocol-level emissions/inflation and governance/validator concentration remain economic and control caveats.

liquidity_executability.notes: CoinGecko shows broad CEX depth across Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, OKX, KuCoin and Gate.

organic_or_financially_substantive: Cross-chain swap/execution demand through NEAR Intents; official site reports $29B+ all-time volume across 35 chains.
Confidential execution/privacy demand; NEAR revenue dashboard reports $113.25M confidential TVL.
Fresh Ondo integration gives eligible users access to tokenized U.S. stocks/ETFs using assets sourced from 30+ networks.
Protocol revenue has direct NEAR value capture via buybacks according to NEAR's revenue dashboard.
incentive_contamination: Confidential TVL crossing $70M triggered Drop 1 of the NEAR@3.33 program: 333,333 milestone tokens for eligible users.
Reward conversion is explicitly conditioned on the NEAR three-day VWAP being at least $3.33, creating a reflexive price-linked incentive.
RHEA/NEAR ecosystem liquidity mining and an emissions-funded MPC infrastructure program mean some ecosystem growth cannot be treated as purely discretionary.
why_capital_is_arriving.classification: MIXED: real cross-chain/product demand is present, but the recent confidential-TVL and token-price impulse is materially incentive-contaminated.

rwa_assessment.notes: Ondo platform-wide TVL/volume cannot be attributed to NEAR. Treat the integration as distribution/access until NEAR-specific balances, secondary turnover and collateral utilization appear.

leadership_and_wallet_quality.relative_performance: Strongly outperforming broader crypto and smart-contract-platform peers.
leadership_and_wallet_quality.notes: No fresh cohort of independently funded, historically selective NEAR spot accumulators was verified. Exchange withdrawals or raw address counts are not substituted for this test.

social_attention.notes: Attention is concentrated around the Intents volume milestone, privacy/confidential perps, the NEAR@3.33 reward condition and the Ondo launch. Treat the sudden narrative concentration as crowding risk rather than confirmation.

decision.reason: The ecosystem/product regime crosses the research-alert threshold, but not the PAPER-buy threshold. NEAR is already +88.6% over seven days; the recent TVL/price impulse is materially contaminated by a price-linked reward program; selective-wallet confirmation is absent; and the fresh RWA catalyst has no NEAR-specific secondary/collateral utilization data yet.
next_confirmation_tests: Intents and NEAR L1 DEX/stablecoin activity persist after the NEAR@3.33 reward effect fades.
NEAR-specific Ondo balances and actual secondary turnover become measurable, ideally with collateral/borrowing use.
Multiple independently funded, historically selective wallets begin repeat NEAR accumulation.
Protocol buybacks/revenue remain strong enough to offset issuance without relying on incentive-driven volume.
